description: Front-matter shape for .vibe-prompt/remediate/pending/<finding-id>.diff staged fix files. Body is a unified diff; this schema validates only the YAML front-matter.

findingCategory.description: Top-level fix category. A = mechanical content drop-in. B = contradiction removal. C = sanitization defense. v0.6+ adds sub-category notation: `B-voice-frame` distinguishes voice-frame rewrites from banned-phrase removals (different confidence + routing).

voiceFrameRewriteRationale.description: v0.6+. Explains how the proposed rewrite aligns with the extracted global-directive voice rule. Populated when findingCategory is `B-voice-frame`.
